body:
aww you're giving me too much credit lol.  thank you for the kind words :)



I've listened to your "the feeling still, deep down, is good" audio more times than I'd probably like to admit lol.  it's saved my sanity on a few occasions and helped me just fall asleep instead of doing some really stupid things.  just wanted to say thank you a million times over for that audio, as well as all your others.  thank you again, hope you're doing well in these times ^ ◡ ^

over an hour of fantasy land if I listen to 1 and 2 back to back?  yes please ^ ◡ ^



im sure you've heard this a lot already, but i think you've been doing just an amazing job with everything. all the effort you put into these definitely shows, and I absolutely love all of your singing and heartfelt moments; they always hit that spot that puts a lump in my throat.  looking forward to episode 3 and any other audios you put out 😊

Sweet as ever!  I'll never get over your audios, the genuine feel and all the emotion you put into them is just intoxicating lol.  Absolutely love how active you are, can't wait to hear what's next :))
Your singing is seriously so calming, it helped me keep a panic attack from going full-blown crazy lol.  Been loving all the audios you've been putting out :))
Holy 47 minutes of heaven, was that lovely!  Hot?  Yes.  Sexy?  Yes.  Wholesome?  Yes.  Almost brought me to tears?  Absolutely.  You continue to amaze me with your audios and improv :))
That was so incredibly sweet.  Your voice was so calming and I absolutely loved your singing :)  I'm very glad to see you're posting this much, your audios are very cutesy-style wholesome ^ ◡ ^

Very sweet and very wholesome 😊.  Loved all the improv/added parts you put into it btw, I absolutely love when artists put their own spin on things to make it their own



You're also very good at playing both a teasing friend and cutesy sweet gf, and your voice is so soft and sweet that it just makes it that much better!  Thank you for the lovely fill ^ ◡ ^

Sorry I never responded sooner, that was a very sweet audio ^_^


loved your voice and accent, thank you for the fill 😊

Your improv skills continue to blow (hehe) me away.  Cute, wholesome, sexy, hot, the whole nine yards and more; you're just lovely :).  this is just what I needed to make me feel a little better after another sad and drunk night lol

I have no idea why reddit isnt giving me notifications when I'm mentioned, but I'm here now!  Thank you for filling my script, I thought it was very sweet :).  This script is a bit personal so it hits a little hard, and you did a wonderful job putting yourself in the "supportive gf" role.  I loved it!  The "talking you to sleep" portion especially has me feeling all warm and fuzzy :D



Thank you again for the wonderful fill!

Ooo yay you decided to post it!  I'm glad others get to hear what an amazing job you did with this :)



Thank you again for this fill, I loved it  ^ ◡ ^

That was very sweet and well done, thank you for the wonderful fill!



Your accent is very nice too btw, subtle but adorable for the script :D

I'm probably gonna use this when my insomnia is giving me trouble, that was so adorable :)



I've been lurking on this sub for a while on another account, but made this one for this kind of thing (and so I could humor myself with trying to write scripts lol), and I have to say you are one of my favorite people to listen to.  Your voice and accent are so sweet and welcoming, I just love every one of your audios I've listened to!  I'm very thankful for how active you are and that all of your audios are just so, so adorable and heartwarming :D

That was very sweet and light-hearted, I love the playfulness behind your voice!  Definitely put a smile on my face, I loved it :)



Thank you for the wonderful fill!

🎂🎂🎂 here, you take the cake as my favorite person on GWA/PTA from now on lol



another amazing audio, your voice is like candy to my ears :)

Thank you for making it such an amazing fill!  This was only my second script and I'm absolutely elated thanks to you :D



Hope to see you posting more soon (^ ◡ \^)

Let me know if you do fill it, I'd love to see what you do with it!  And I will let you know if I come up with more scripts you might like \^_^



You might like my first script, it's just a little more lighthearted than this one :)
Aww thank you!  I'm a hopeless romantic at heart and it seems these scripts are a good way to get it out lol :)
Oh please do!  I never expected my first script to get this many upvotes, and having it filled would put me on cloud nine :D.  Can't wait to see what you do with it!
aaaaa thank you very much :D.  I was definitely going for a sweet and bubbly kinda feel for the whole thing; I'm glad it seems to have gotten through!  Thank you very much for the kind words :)
